lines.text: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge;
let me never be put to shame.
In Your justice, rescue and deliver me;
incline Your ear and save me.
Give the command to save me,
for You are my rock and my fortress.
Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked,
from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.
For You are my hope, O Lord GOD,
I have leaned on You since birth;
You pulled me from my mother’s womb.
My praise is always for You.
I have become a portent to many,
but You are my strong refuge.
My mouth is filled with Your praise
and with Your splendor all day long.

pictures.scene: Carl Bloch, A Young girl knocking at the fisherman's window - a child come in from the dark to knock at a lit window for shelter, taking refuge in the LORD and asking never to be put to shame
pictures.name: pd_bloch_girl_at_fishermans_window

pictures.scene: Jan Victors, Hanna, moeder van Samuel, biddend in de tempel - Hannah kneeling in the temple with her hands open in petition, asking God in His justice to incline His ear and save
pictures.name: pd_victors_hanna_biddend_in_de_tempel

pictures.scene: Guillam Dubois, Berglandschap - a great standing rock above a wooded valley, the rock of refuge where the psalmist can always go
pictures.name: pd_dubois_berglandschap

pictures.scene: Markus Pernhart, Hochosterwitz - a walled fortress set on its own crag above the plain, God commanded to save because He is rock and fortress
pictures.name: pd_pernhart_burg_hochosterwitz

pictures.scene: Sebastiaen Vrancx, Soldaten plunderen een boerderij - armed men breaking into a farmstead and carrying off what they find, deliverance sought from the hand of the wicked and the grasp of the ruthless
pictures.name: pd_vrancx_soldaten_plunderen_een_boerderij

pictures.scene: Giuseppe Canella, Chioggia vor Sonnenaufgang - the harbour quiet in the pale light before the sun comes up, the LORD as hope and as confidence from youth
pictures.name: pd_canella_chioggia_vor_sonnenaufgang

pictures.scene: Albert Neuhuys, Moeder en kind - a mother bent over the small child in her lap in a dim cottage, leaning on God since birth and pulled from the mother's womb
pictures.name: pd_neuhuys_moeder_en_kind

pictures.scene: Ilya Repin, They Did Not Expect Him - a gaunt man walking in at the door while the whole household turns and stares, praise always for God though the psalmist has become a portent to many
pictures.name: pd_repin_zij_verwachtten_hem_niet

pictures.scene: Jan Weissenbruch, De kerk van St Denis te Luik - the heavy old church tower standing above the street, God the strong refuge and the mouth filled with His praise
pictures.name: pd_weissenbruch_kerk_van_st_denis_te_luik

pictures.scene: Anna Ancher, Solskin i den blindes stue - a blind old woman sitting in the sunlight that fills her small room, His splendor all day long and the plea not to be discarded in old age
pictures.name: pd_ancher_solskin_i_den_blindes_stue
